input.quote: (h) This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Nova Scotia and the laws of Canada applicable in Nova Scotia. All disputes under this Agreement shall be subject to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Nova Scotia.
input.rationale: Nova Scotia law and courts are outside our accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales). We replaced only the jurisdiction and forum words with New York law and the courts of New York County; Delaware, California or England and Wales are acceptable fallbacks. There is no arbitration clause.

input.quote: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
input.rationale: The assignment bar is absolute with no reasonableness standard and no affiliate or M&A/successor carve-out for us, and Section 3(c) separately blocks any transfer of the Work without Garman's written consent. We added the affiliate/successor carve-out for Sparkling, a reasonableness standard for other assignments, and confirmed a change of control gives Garman no termination or re-pricing right (none currently appears in Section 17, which is helpful).

input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Garman retaining its platform IP is acceptable, but the clause also vests the Modifications and Improvements we commission and pay for (Schedule "D") solely in Garman with no licence back beyond the object-code licence, and the Agreement never confirms that our data — including data converted under Section 4 — remains ours. We added a data-ownership sentence, a perpetual royalty-free licence to paid-for Modifications/Improvements, and a no-joint-ownership statement.

input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
input.rationale: Affiliates are covered only while operating at Authorized Locations, contractors/outsourcers acting for us are not covered at all, and the licence is expressly non-transferable, so it would not follow us into an M&A transaction. We extended the grant to contractors, made it irrevocable and transferable to a successor; adding locations remains subject to the Fee Schedule.
